Message: Hi there!

So walking home yesterday after the big rain storm, I passed your house (and noticed your dog! Still so fluffy)  & something I haven' noticed until today caught a smile on me : )

Just beyond your bushes, right by our mail boxes (if I recall that part from last year right?) - the lil' pink cherry tomatoes are already peek-ing! 🤯 

So fresh, plucky, ready-to-pour-salsa-on 'zums! It was like finding hidden fruit on the ground. And it's a beautiful sign that Spring truly arrived! 😎 

Wanted a chance for us both (I'm not much in tomatoes, so we'll see if it survives) - to say thanks again! 

Hope all well with ya. Take some nice care out there
